paper_title: Piezoelectrically Tuned Multimode Cavity Search for Axion Dark Matter
notes: ADMX Sidecar pathfinder haloscope, three frequency bands (Run A: 4202-4249 MHz TM010, Run B: 5086-5799 MHz TM010, Run C: 7173-7203 MHz TM020) corresponding to axion masses 17.38-17.57, 21.03-23.98, 29.67-29.79 ueV. Exclusion on g_agamma at 90% CL, rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3 isothermal. Numerical coupling values estimated from Fig. 4 (y-axis 1e-13 to 1e-10 GeV^-1); paper gives no exclusion table so values are approximate readings from the plot.
